usage: cox chair watchdog [-h] [--idle-minutes IDLE_MINUTES] [--stale-minutes STALE_MINUTES]
                          [--dry-run] [--profile PROFILE]

A one-shot check meant for a five-minute timer.
It reads only the store and exits 0 whether or not it pushed.
It exits 1 only when the store cannot be read.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --idle-minutes IDLE_MINUTES
                        minutes of idle status lines before an alert (default: 30)
  --stale-minutes STALE_MINUTES
                        minutes without a lease beat before the loop is down (default: 10)
  --dry-run             print each alert and push nothing
  --profile PROFILE     the routing profile (default: ~/.config/agent-tools/profile.yaml or
                        $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
